columns.name: PROFILE_CLASS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the customer profile class

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - application id of the program that last updated this row (foreign key to FND_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_ID).

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer profile class

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - program id of the program that last updated this row (foreign key to FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - date when a program last updated this row).

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if this customer profile class is active or inactive

columns.name: WH_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the record was entered or changed in a data warehouse

columns.name: COLLECTOR_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the collector associated with this customer profile class

columns.name: CREDIT_ANALYST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of credit analyst associated with this customer profile class

columns.name: CREDIT_CHECKING
columns.description: Indicates if credit must be checked. Y for required credit checking, N for optional credit checking

columns.name: TOLERANCE
columns.description: Percentage over credit limit that this customer can exceed before collection action is taken

columns.name: DISCOUNT_TERMS
columns.description: Indicates if discount terms are allowed. Y for discount terms allowed, N for no discount terms.

columns.name: DUNNING_LETTERS
columns.description: Indicates if dunning letters are sent to this customer when invoices, debit memos or chargebacks become past due. Y for  dunning letters are sent, N for no dunning letters.

columns.name: INTEREST_CHARGES
columns.description: Indicates if late charges are enabled

columns.name: STATEMENTS
columns.description: Indicates if statements are sent to this customer. Y for statements are sent, N for no statements. Default value is Y.

columns.name: CREDIT_BALANCE_STATEMENTS
columns.description: Indicates if statements with credit balances are sent to this customer. Y for statements are sent, N for no statements.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the customer credit profile class

columns.name: REVIEW_CYCLE_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days between account reviews

columns.name: OUTSIDE_REPORTING
columns.description: Indicates whether to report creditworthiness outside the company. Y for credit information is provided to third parties, N for no reporting to third parties about customer creditworthiness.

columns.name: STANDARD_TERMS
columns.description: User-defined payment terms

columns.name: OVERRIDE_TERMS
columns.description: Indicates if the user is allowed to override standard terms. Y for allowing user to override stand terms. N for preventing users from overriding standard terms.

columns.name: COMBINE_DUNNING_LETTERS
columns.description: Indicates whether to combine dunning letters for this customer profile. Y for combined dunning letters, N for separate dunning letters.

columns.name: INTEREST_PERIOD_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days that the interest rate applies to

columns.name: AUTOCASH_HIERARCHY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the autocash hierarchy associated with this customer profile class

columns.name: PAYMENT_GRACE_DAYS
columns.description: Maximum number of overdue days allowed before action is taken

columns.name: DISCOUNT_GRACE_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days after discount term date that this customer can take discounts

columns.name: STATEMENT_CYCLE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the statement cycle associated with this customer profile

columns.name: CONS_INV_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if balance forward bill is generated and  sent to customer. Y for yes, N or null for no.

columns.name: CONS_INV_TYPE
columns.description: Format of balance forward bill. SUMMARY, DETAIL, or IMPORTED. Validated against HZ_CONS_INV_TYPE  lookup type

columns.name: AUTOCASH_HIERARCHY_ID_FOR_ADR
columns.description: Identifies AutoCash Rule Set to be used for applying the remainder balance on a receipt for the customer during Post Batch processing.

columns.name: LOCKBOX_MATCHING_OPTION
columns.description: Lockbox matching option (typically INVOICE, SALES_ORDER, or PURCHASE_ORDER)

columns.name: REVIEW_CYCLE
columns.description: Review cycle of customer profile data

columns.name: CREDIT_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Measure of customer credit worthiness.

columns.name: CONS_BILL_LEVEL
columns.description: Level at which balance forward billing  is done, ACCOUNT or SITE. Validated against HZ_CONS_BILL_LEVEL lookup type

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_CALCULATION_TRX
columns.description: Indicates whether late charges should be calculated on overdue invoices and or late payments. Validated against lookup type AR_MANDATORY_LATE_CHARGES.

columns.name: CREDIT_ITEMS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if credit items such as  unapplied or on-account receipts, can be offset against the overdue balance to reduce the amount liable.

columns.name: DISPUTED_TRANSACTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if late charges can be  calculated on disputed transactions

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TYPE
columns.description: Determines if late charges should be recorded as an adjustment, debit memo or interest invoice. Validated against lookup type AR_LATE_CHARGE_TYPE

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term used when an invoice or debit memo is created for late charges. Foreign key to  RA_TERMS.PAYMENT_TERM_ID.

columns.name: INTEREST_CALCULATION_PERIOD
columns.description: Indicates if interest calculation period for late charges is daily or monthly. Validated against lookup type AR_CALCULATION_PERIOD.

columns.name: HOLD_CHARGED_INVOICES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if late charges can be calculated more than once for a transaction

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT_ID
columns.description: Message text printed on the late charge transaction. Applies only to late charges recorded as invoices or debit memos. Foreign key to AR_STANDARD_TEXT.STANDARD_TEXT_ID.

columns.name: MULTIPLE_INTEREST_RATES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if interest and penalty charges can be calculated using multiple rates for a single late charge period

columns.name: CHARGE_BEGIN_DATE
columns.description: Optional value that indicates the date late charges begin.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PREF_CONTACT_METHOD
columns.description: Preferred contact method

columns.name: AUTOMATCH_RULE_ID
columns.description:
AUTOMATCH_RULE_ID is the identifier of new setup entity AutoMatch, which will signify how automatching will be performed in 
AutoMatch Program.

columns.name: MATCH_BY_AUTOUPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: MATCH_BY_AUTOUPDATE_FLAG indicates if Match Receipt By attribute should be updated at customer level (site and account profile)

columns.name: EXCEPTION_RULE_ID
columns.description: Exception Rule Identifier rule governs the rules for Over/Under Applications

columns.name: OFFSET_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days used to calculate the expiration date of an authorization.

columns.name: CREDIT_LIMIT
columns.description: Maximum amount of credit defined in the single currency on the customer profile class.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate type associated with the authorization currency. The default value is Corporate.

columns.name: CREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code associated with the credit limit.

columns.name: CREDIT_REVIEW_CYCLE
columns.description: Period of a customer credit review cycle based on a list of values from user-defined values in the AR_LOOKUPS table. Review cycle must be predefined in the PERIODIC_REVIEW_CYCLE lookup type.

columns.name: STMT_DELIVERY_METHOD
columns.description: Method of delivering statements to the customer. Valid values are E-Mail,PRINT and XML.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT
columns.description: Maximum order amount defined in the credit currency on the customer profile class.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_ADJ_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for adjustment activity against a transaction during a receipt application.Reasons are configued as lookup codes of the ADJUST_REASON lookup type.

columns.name: ENABLE_CONS_BILLING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a customer account is enabled for consolidated billing.

columns.name: DRAFT_BILL_REVIEW_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a draft consolidated invoice requires review before final billing.

columns.name: CONS_BILLING_TERM_ID
columns.description: Consolidated billing terms identifier.
